screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Money is useful. But it can't do everything.

screens.title: Two kinds of good things

cards.caption: Some things you can buy with money.
Some things are free. No money can buy them.

screens.penny: The best things are often free, {name}.

screens.prompt: Put each picture in the right basket.
screens.pennyHint: Ask yourself: could a shop sell it, {name}?
screens.rightMessage: Nice sorting, {name}! That's a good basket for it.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Look again. Could a shop put a price on it?
screens.doneMessage: All sorted, {name}! Shops sell things. They don't sell hugs.

screens.prompt: Can you buy a best friend with coins?
screens.pennyHint: Think about how friends are made, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: That's right, {name}! Friends come from kindness, not coins.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! No shop sells friends. Kindness makes friends.

screens.story: Priya is feeling sad today. Her friend Leo has 5 coins.
screens.pennyHint: What does a sad friend really need, {name}?

options.label: Sit with her and listen
options.outcome: Priya feels better. Leo gave her time, not coins.

options.label: Buy her a sweet
options.outcome: A sweet is a kind thought. Priya still feels alone, though.

options.label: Give her all 5 coins
options.outcome: That is generous. But Priya wanted a friend to listen.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Time and listening cost nothing, and they help a lot.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Treats are kind. Sitting with a sad friend helps more.

screens.prompt: So what is money good for?
screens.pennyHint: One more question, then we're done, {name}!

choices.label: Trading for things we need and want
Making a person better than others

screens.rightMessage: That's it, {name}! Money is a tool for trading. That's all.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Money never makes anyone better. It just buys things.
screens.retryIntro: One last look, {name}. What is money for?

screens.title: Lesson done, {name}!
screens.message: Money buys things. Kindness does the rest.
